# ForkAI
> ForkAI is a multi-AI chat workspace for branching conversations, comparing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other models on shared context, and selectively sharing useful paths.

## Main pages
- [ForkAI homepage](https://forkai.tech/): Product overview, branching workflow, supported use cases, pricing, and frequently asked questions.
- [Branching AI chat guide](https://forkai.tech/branching-ai-chat): Detailed explanation of branching conversations, model comparison, research workflows, and selective sharing.
- [Privacy policy and terms](https://forkai.tech/policy): Account, conversation, billing, and privacy terms.
- [Early access](https://forkai.tech/prelaunch): Join the ForkAI early-access waitlist.

## Product facts
- ForkAI preserves the source conversation when a user explores an alternate branch.
- Users can switch between and compare ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI models without rebuilding the prompt context.
- Shared views can contain selected messages or a focused summary instead of an entire private conversation.

## Canonical identity
- Name: ForkAI
- Alternate name: Fork AI
- Website: https://forkai.tech/
